thread:
tara_prod: Heads-up: vendor emailed a revised HW roadmap. H100 GA stays, H200 moved mid-Apr, MI300 requires a patched image for marketplace certification, Gaudi has a compat note for older kernels. Need a quick cross-org check.

ben_vendor: Correct. MI300 images will include kernel module km-0.9 that must be present in our marketplace image. Gaudi older kernels (<=5.10) show a small memcpy perf regression; recommendation: use kernel 5.15 in images.

sam_eng: If MI300 needs km-0.9 we should centralize the module and version it in our image builder. Also we need to update perf expectations if Gaudi on 5.10. Any timeline for the patched images?

ben_vendor: Partner engineering hopes to deliver MI300 patched images and km-0.9 by EOD +2 business days. H200 slip to 2025-04-12.

mina_market: Marketplace requirements: we need image SHAs, kernel version declared, and legal-approved partner blurb before SKU row unlock. Also regional availability (APAC EU US) must be explicit. 10 business days prep after receiving final artifacts.

josh_si: SI asks: provide integration checklist including kernel/module list, a minimal repro for memory regressions on Gaudi if possible, and a soak plan targeting EU-WEST and US-WEST for 48h.

alert-bot: tara_prod added calendar event: "HW roadmap quick triage: MI300 kernel + Gaudi compat" scheduled 2025-03-22 11:00 PT with tara_prod, ben_vendor, sam_eng, mina_market, josh_si. Invite sent.

sam_eng: Quick image naming proposal: `redwood/mkt/{vendor}/{model}/kernel-{ver}/sha-{short}`. Example: `redwood/mkt/vendorx/mi300/kernel-5.15/sha-a1b2c3`. I'll open a PR for CI gating.

ben_vendor: We'll adopt the naming. Will include kernel declaration in image metadata.

mina_market: Action items before sync:
- ben_vendor: deliver patched MI300 images + km-0.9 + SKU impact list (due: EOD +2 days)
- sam_eng: PR for image naming + CI gating rules (due: +48h)
- josh_si: SI soak template + repro steps request (due: +48h)
- mina_market: embargo draft + regional availability checklist (due: sync)

josh_si: Note: if Gaudi regression is confirmed, SI will recommend kernel-5.15-only images for Gaudi SKUs; that may affect customers on legacy stacks. We'll document migration notes.

tara_prod: Good. If we get images on time and CI passes, we'll keep H100/H200 marketing cadence. If not, we'll shift marketplace unlock by the same delta. Post blockers here.

ben_vendor: Copying partner PM to invite.

mina_market: I'll add legal and PR to the invite.

alert-bot: Thread pinned to event notes.
